== Summary ==
A custom foil card titled "Hunt Down And Destroy The English" (Wales v England), the trophy of the Wales–England team rivalry, photographed at the [[2015 European Championship]] on 17 October 2015. Printed results: Euro worlds 2012: Wales; UK Nats 2013: England; Euro Championship 2013: England; later results are added by hand. Team Wales listed: Kevin Jaap, John Moorley, Marc Nickels, Peter Rowlands; Team England: Paul McPherson, Darren Pilbeam, Dan Price, Ben Smyth, Kristian Lund.

* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2015-10-27
